text: 一批增量政策密集落地；美联储加息预期骤降｜一周热点回顾 国务院常务会议部署推出系列增量政策，首套房贷贴息全国落地，央行出台一揽子货币政策工具调整方案。
text_en: A batch of incremental policies implemented intensively; Fed rate hike expectations plummet | Weekly hotspot review: The State Council executive meeting deployed a series of incremental policies, first-home mortgage interest subsidies rolled out nationwide, and the PBOC introduced a package of monetary policy tool adjustment plans.
